NOTE FOR HUMAN REVIEW: CARE's URL slug for that page reads 'srivastava-s-k-cardiologist' (S K) while the page TITLE reads 'Srivastava Ak' (A K). The URL is recorded exactly as it was returned in search results and was NOT corrected or reconstructed; the slug/title initial mismatch is CARE's own inconsistency and someone should confirm the initials once. Corroborated by Practo, MediBuddy, HexaHealth and DocIndia listings for an 'A K Srivastava', Cardiologist, Hyderabad. Band is Medium not High: every carehospitals.com page counts as ONE official source, and Practo/MediBuddy/HexaHealth/DocIndia are corroborating-only directories that can never earn High. Srivastava, Cardiologist' at Hyderguda / Himayatnagar, Hyderabad.
